_doc: עוד סבב SFX cues. Owner: Audio Director. Written by audio/tools/compose_od.py; rendered by tools/gen_od_sevev.gd to game/assets/audio/od/<cue>_<key>_<pitch>_<variant>.res (QOA one-shots). Layers use the lib_dsp layer schema; tonal layers with followPitch (the default) are authored with A4 = the cue's root, i.e. degree 1 of the key in rootOctave (A4 = 1, B4 = 2, C5 = b3, D5 = 4, E5 = 5, F5 = b6, G5 = b7, G#4 = the raised 7 below, A5 = 1'). The 'degrees' pitch type counts scale steps of the key's mode ('3' = the mode's third, minor in D/E/G, major in F Mixolydian). The generator computes each cue's play_db from its loudness target (K-weighted, BS.1770, measured as dual mono), capped by the bus ceiling; the manifest carries it. Target types: burst = the loudest 100 ms (transients shorter than the 400 ms momentary window), momentary = the loudest 400 ms, shortTerm = the loudest 3 s of a steady stream at rateHz, stream = integrated over 12 s at rateHz, relative = burst dB under another cue.

keys._doc: The four playing keys. Taps, pings, Dubi and every keyed cue render once per key; the runtime plays the key of the track that is playing (G during court day).

modes._doc: minor = HaTikva's natural minor (the tap walk and Dubi's bank); the music raises the 7th at cadences. Washington (F) stays Mixolydian so its taps agree with its stride body.

buses._doc: mix-bus-topology (audio/od/cue-spec.md §3). Levels live in play_db; buses sit at 0 dB.

ceilings._doc: Heard sample-peak ceiling per bus (dBFS at the bus, before the master): play_db is capped so a file's peak lands at or under it, whatever its loudness target asks. Keeps SFX + music under the -1 dB master limiter in normal play.

babbleContours._doc: Canned squawks (voice/copy-deck §H): the parrot repeats what he was told, so each line has a fixed contour of [degree, octave] per blip; a doubled line repeats its contour after a 150 ms gap.

crits._doc: v1.3 (leader-select spec §9.5): the crit cue of a react event. A leader's event is kit.tap.critEvent; Bibi (critAnim 'crit', the rabbit prop) is 'rabbit'. rabbitCrit keeps its round-robin; the others play critReact's variant of the same name. An unknown event plays 'land'. The tap itself stays the shared tap cue for everyone.

tap.meaning: The trick worked; money came out.
tap.runtime: Step = the tap streak index mod 8 (walk and wrap); the streak resets after 400 ms without a tap. Variant alternates d25 / d12 per tap. Gain jitter +-1.5 dB. One file = one tap.

rabbitCrit.runtime: Round-robin s120 -> s150 -> s180. The head's 16ths are a fixed 75 ms in every era so the whole cue stays <= 600 ms (brief §5 cue 2).

suitcaseSpawn.meaning: A catchable opportunity is on screen.
suitcaseSpawn.pan: the suitcase's x mapped to -0.4..+0.4 on the 'Suitcase' bus panner, set at spawn
suitcaseSpawn.runtime: Random variant (gate rate 25/28/31 Hz). The whoosh is UX's spawn twin (first-minute §3).

suitcaseCatch.runtime: Also the first half of the 'while you were away' return (returnAway).

suitcaseMiss.meaning: It reached its destination. Nobody knew. (deadpan)
suitcaseMiss.runtime: One quiet TRI bwomp down a semitone, under the ticker line. Nothing else.

shapes.gafni: 1, then the second note left the room
shapes.gotliv: b3 -> the raised 7 below: a diminished fourth, between rows
shapes.left: 1 -> b2 up, unresolved, and a door click
shapes.brawl: 1+b2 / b6+5 / 1+b2: two pings talking over each other

chatPing.runtime: Variant = the partner id (unknown partners: default). At most one ping per 700 ms; pings inside that window coalesce into one 'burst'. Never during a Dubi squawk: queue it until 300 ms after Dubi stops (UX first-minute §9). 'left' = left the group.

ultimatumTick.meaning: Pay before zero or they walk.
ultimatumTick.runtime: One per displayed second, alternating tick/tock. In the last 3 s: two per second, and force L2 off (tension by subtraction). No duck (a tick every 500 ms would pump the music).

ultimatumZero.meaning: Time ran out: they left the group.
ultimatumZero.runtime: A TRI deflate a minor third down (b3 -> 1), then the 'left the group' ping. No alarm beep, ever.

gavel.runtime: Then the music moves to the courthouse track at the next bar line, where courtIn starts.

gavelWeak.runtime: One weak knock, an octave up. The 'tik'.

courtOut.meaning: Court day is over; back to the era.
courtOut.runtime: Two TRI tiptoe notes, 5 -> 1' in the era key being returned to, on the crossfade bar line.

stamp.runtime: Deliberately identical (+-0.5 dB at most). Every 5th stamp plays the 'bell' variant.

transferWhistle.meaning: A partner switched jerseys (the transfer window).
transferWhistle.runtime: Random variant. Pitch-stable, no glide, 740 ms in total: siren-safe (brief §2).

shutter.meaning: You caught the people who live in our cameras (photobomb).
shutter.runtime: Random variant (the pip +-1 semitone). The 'שלום בית בפריים' trophy plays the trophy stinger instead (shutter + the full motif on BLIP).

dubiSquawk.runtime: Before a spoken line: 'up' before a headline, 'down' before a flash. +-7 semitones over 80 ms.

dubiBlip.runtime: Replaces the F-pentatonic babble bank (ADR 0003). One blip per displayed syllable (about 1 per 2 Hebrew letters) at 8 per second; degrees drawn from the bank (seeded by the text), a final '!' steps up to the next higher degree. Capped at 1.6 s. The ticker babbles on at most one headline per 20 s. Canned lines use babbleContours instead.

returnAway.runtime: The catch's cha-ching, then the motif head (5-1). v1.3: a first sound like leaderPick (the return card comes before any tap after a reload, so the first-tap gate used to swallow it).

buy.meaning: Bought a source or a spin.
buy.runtime: The tap blip on 5, then the motif's first bar note (1') on P1. Alternate d25 / d12.

cantAfford.runtime: Two quiet P2 staccatos on the raised leading tone, left hanging.

uiClick.runtime: One P2 blip on degree 1 in octave 6 (1.2-1.6 kHz).

coin.meaning: Coins (the settings 'צ'ינג' preview; payout sparkle, at most 6 per tap).
coin.runtime: The deadpan rule: the payout never scales loudness or count (<= 6 coins per tap, whatever the sum).

leaderPick.meaning: You picked this round's leader (the picker's commit).
leaderPick.runtime: On the picker's commit (and again on a re-pick inside the undo window). It is the game's first sound now: it plays before the first-tap gate, and while the web audio context is still locked it is held (up to 5 s) and plays on the unlock, like the motif. It does not open the first-tap gate: the first tap still plays the motif.

critReact.meaning: A crit (every leader but Bibi): the leader's react landed.
critReact.runtime: Variant = the react strip's event (crits table). Fires on that event's frame (sprites.json chars.<art>.anims.<critAnim>.events), a third of the delay in reduced motion, like rabbitCrit.

decline.meaning: You declined a partner's demand (Liberman's rule).
decline.runtime: On the decline pill's commit. The partner's 'left' ping is the sim's business, not this cue.

merge.meaning: Two members merged into one (Golan's rule).

suspicionHot.runtime: Once per upward crossing of 75 % (the view's calm -> hot change). Silent at 95 % (boiling): the visual boil and the coming gavel carry it.

slipStamp.meaning: The ballot slip is stamped (a spin card's tag appears or changes: '1/5' -> '2/5', 'שחוק').
slipStamp.runtime: On the slam's f0 (the x6 frame) in shop.gd; in reduced motion on the cut. It often lands with `buy` (the purchase that changed the tag): it sits 4.5 dB under it, centred at 0.7 kHz under its 1-4 kHz blips. Repeats per purchase, so it sits 2 dB under the stamp's heard -18.5 (0.5 over uiClick).
